title: B1 as a sizing-estimator test: volatility estimators inside the vol-target loop (not as regime features)
status: FROZEN 2026-09-03 before any run; gate calibration = winner of calibration_memory (rolling if RETIRE)
rationale: Decision D1 moved volatility to the sizing layer, so the natural test of range-based volatility is head-to-head against the incumbent EWMA inside the vol-target — the format that chose EWMA over EGARCH (volatility-estimator policy, 2026-08-31).

estimators.E0: EWMA λ=0.94 of squared daily log close-to-close returns, 60-day warm-up (incumbent)
estimators.E1: Yang-Zhang (2000) over a rolling 21-day window: overnight variance + k·open-to-close variance + (1-k)·Rogers-Satchell, k = 0.34/(1.34 + (n+1)/(n-1))
estimators.E2: Parkinson (1980) EWMA λ=0.94 of (ln H/L)^2 / (4 ln 2) — isolates the range information from the window choice
estimators.E3: K-ATR fast parity arm: the screener's 2-state LLT Kalman (q_level 1e-4, q_slope 1e-6, R 1e-3) on log true-range-% (perf_metrics.py), exp back, converted to annualised vol with E[H-L] = 2·sqrt(2/pi)·sigma ≈ 1.596·sigma (driftless Brownian motion; TR >= H-L so this arm is biased upward, i.e. sizes smaller — reported, not corrected)

P2_3x.construction: letf_voltarget_trend.py §14.1: estimator on the leveraged fund's own OHLC; rebalance on gate flip or band exit

execution: sigma and gate known at close T-1; t+0; 5+3 bp one-way on units traded; cash = T-bill

metrics_primary.tracking: RMSE of rolling-63-day realised vol of the ungated sized strategy around sigma_target, and |full-sample realised vol - target| (measurement quality: lower is better)
metrics_primary.outcome: Sharpe and Martin of the gated strategy (paired vs E0, bootstrap CI)

decision_rule.ADOPT_estimator: beats E0 on tracking RMSE in >= 6/8 (P1) and >= 5/7 (P2) names AND does not lose Sharpe (median ΔSharpe >= -0.02) AND turnover not more than 1.25x E0
decision_rule.RETIRE: otherwise; a tracking win with a Sharpe loss is reported as 'measurement better, sizing worse' and not adopted
